approved_therapies_count.label: Number of approved drugs in this indication (any mechanism)
approved_therapies_count.source: openFDA drug/label indications_and_usage; ChEMBL drug_indication max_phase_for_ind=4

soc_last_new_moa_years.label: Years since the last approval of a new mechanism in the indication

active_comparator_exists.label: An active comparator exists (not only supportive care)

approved_same_moa_count.label: Approved drugs with the same mechanism in this indication
approved_same_moa_count.source: ChEMBL mechanism + drug_indication; Open Targets drugAndClinicalCandidates

ph3_same_moa_count.label: Drugs with the same mechanism in Phase 3 (including Chinese sponsors)

years_behind_first_in_class.label: Years from the first approval in the class to the expected launch

soc_loe_before_launch.label: Standard of care loses exclusivity before or soon after launch

required_price_unrealistic.label: Required annual price is unrealistic for the addressable population
required_price_unrealistic.source: Calculation: target peak / number treated; epidemiology from open sources

medicare_negotiation_exposure.label: The drug falls under Medicare price negotiation (IRA) during its peak

genetic_support.label: Genetic support for the target–disease pair. none = the disease has genetic data, but it does not support this target; no_data = the disease has no genetic data at all
genetic_support.source: Open Targets: datasourceScores of the pair (not the overall score). Mendelian: gene2phenotype, clingen, genomics_england, orphanet, ClinVar (eva), uniprot_literature; GWAS with a confident gene: gwas_credible_sets with L2G ≥ 0.5; somatic: intogen, cancer_gene_census. Validation on pairs used OMIM, which has a restricted licence; the open sources approximate it

moa_clinical_precedent.label: Clinical precedent of the same mechanism (same target and same direction of action): any drug in this disease, or this or another drug in another disease; a related disease means the same therapeutic area
moa_clinical_precedent.source: Open Targets knownDrugs of the target (phase, status, mechanism) + disease.therapeuticAreas; ClinicalTrials.gov results

independent_groups.label: How many independent groups reproduced the key result (do not count the authors of the original work)

perturbation_evidence.label: Causal preclinical evidence: knocking out or blocking the target changes the disease phenotype in cells, tissue or animals

correlational_evidence.label: Correlational evidence: target expression, changes in diseased tissue, pathway membership

moa_discontinued_safety_count.label: How many programs on this target were discontinued for safety

moa_crl_safety.label: Another drug with the same mechanism received a CRL for safety
moa_crl_safety.source: FDA letters (since 2025), press releases, company filings

moa_adcom_negative.label: An FDA advisory committee voted against another drug with the same mechanism

class_drug_related_deaths.label: Trials of drugs of the same class had drug-related deaths

indication_accelerated_withdrawn.label: Accelerated approvals in this disease were withdrawn

indication_enrollment_terminations_high.label: Trials in this disease were often stopped for enrollment

foundational_retraction.label: The foundational paper was retracted
foundational_retraction.source: Retraction Watch / Crossref; PubMed publication type

moa_failures_efficacy_ph23.label: OTHER drugs (not this asset) with the same mechanism, direction and disease that failed Phase 2/3 for efficacy
moa_failures_efficacy_ph23.source: ClinicalTrials.gov whyStopped, resultsSection; only futility or a missed endpoint

moa_successes_same_indication.label: Successes of the same mechanism in this disease (positive Phase 2/3 or approval)

indication_graveyard.label: The indication is on the curated 'graveyard' list (history of failures, poor translation, high placebo response)

indication_failures_other_moa_ph3_10y.label: Phase 3 efficacy failures of OTHER mechanisms in this indication over 10 years

indication_ph3_outcomes_other_moa.label: How many OTHER targets have a known Phase 3 outcome in this disease

indication_ph3_success_share_other_moa.label: Share of OTHER targets that passed Phase 3 in this disease (0–1)

indication_new_moa_approvals_10y.label: Approvals of new mechanisms in this indication over 10 years

life_threatening_indication.label: The disease is directly life-threatening (oncology and similar)

class_safety_signal.label: The class (same target or format) has a boxed warning or a known adverse effect

class_withdrawal.label: A drug of the same class was withdrawn for safety

target_safety_flags.label: Composite target safety flag, 0–6
target_safety_flags.source: Open Targets geneticConstraint, prioritisation, safetyLiabilities, interactions

essential_gene.label: The target is a common essential gene (DepMap common essential)

moa_direction.label: Direction of action on the target

modality_target_mismatch.label: The modality physically cannot reach the target
modality_target_mismatch.source: Open Targets target.tractability + localisation from UniProt

tractability.label: Highest tractability bucket for this modality and target

accepted_endpoint_exists.label: A regulator-accepted endpoint exists for the indication
accepted_endpoint_exists.source: FDA surrogate endpoint table; FDA guidance for the disease

endpoint_approval_precedent.label: There is an approval precedent in the indication on this endpoint (stronger if the mechanism column matches)
endpoint_approval_precedent.source: FDA Table of Surrogate Endpoints; openFDA label

natural_history_data.label: Natural history data for the disease exist

fda_designations_count.label: Number of FDA designations (orphan, breakthrough, fast track, RMAT)
fda_designations_count.source: FDA Orphan Drug Designations; press releases
fda_designations_count.dd: Which FDA designations does the asset have, and on what data were they granted?

phase.label: Asset stage
phase.dd: At what development stage is the asset in this indication?

animal_model_response.label: Response in an animal model of the disease
animal_model_response.dd: Is there a response in a relevant animal model, and who reproduced it?

pillars_human.label: How many of the three pillars are shown in humans (exposure at the site of action, target binding, pharmacological effect)
pillars_human.source: Phase 1 endpoints in ClinicalTrials.gov; data room
pillars_human.dd: Has exposure at the site of action, target binding and pharmacological effect been shown in humans?

link_exposure.label: Link 2: effective exposure is reachable in the right tissue in humans (false = known not to be)
link_exposure.dd: Is effective exposure reachable safely in humans, and does the drug reach the right tissue?

link_target_engagement.label: Link 3: target engagement shown in humans in the relevant tissue (false = known not to be)
link_target_engagement.source: Phase 1 (PD, receptor occupancy); data room; input
link_target_engagement.dd: Has target engagement been shown in relevant human tissue?

link_pd_response.label: Link 4: biological response in humans, a pharmacodynamic biomarker changes (false = known not to)
link_pd_response.dd: Does a pharmacodynamic biomarker change in humans, and does it predict clinical benefit?

own_ph2_positive.label: The asset's own Phase 2 in this indication met its primary endpoint
own_ph2_positive.dd: What are the results of the asset's own trials in this indication: were primary endpoints met, were there failures?

own_trial_failed_efficacy.label: The asset's own trial in this indication failed for efficacy
own_trial_failed_efficacy.dd: What are the results of the asset's own trials in this indication: were primary endpoints met, were there failures?

drug_approved_other_indication.label: This drug is already approved in another indication (whether it is related is set by moa_clinical_precedent)
drug_approved_other_indication.dd: Is this drug approved in another indication, and in which jurisdictions?

randomized_controlled.label: The registrational (pivotal) trial is randomized and controlled
randomized_controlled.dd: What is the design of the pivotal trial, and why was it chosen?

endpoint_matches_mechanism.label: The primary endpoint measures what the drug is supposed to do
endpoint_matches_mechanism.dd: What is the primary endpoint, and how is it linked to the drug's mechanism of action?

dose_ranging_done.label: Phase 2 compared at least two dose levels
dose_ranging_done.dd: Provide the dose-selection data: which levels were compared, and how was the Phase 3 dose chosen?

open_label_subjective_endpoint.label: Open-label design with a subjective primary endpoint
open_label_subjective_endpoint.dd: What is the design of the pivotal trial, and why was it chosen?

biomarker_selection.label: Patients are selected by a biomarker
biomarker_selection.dd: Are patients selected by a biomarker, and is there a validated test for it?

posthoc_subgroup_thesis.label: The thesis rests on a subgroup found post hoc
posthoc_subgroup_thesis.source: ClinicalTrials.gov: failure in all patients, new trial in a subgroup
posthoc_subgroup_thesis.dd: Does the thesis rest on a subgroup found after a failure in all patients?

single_country_ex_us_pivotal.label: Registrational data from a single country outside the US
single_country_ex_us_pivotal.dd: In which countries were the registrational trials run, and has this been agreed with the FDA?

single_arm_pivotal.label: The registrational trial is single-arm
single_arm_pivotal.dd: What is the design of the pivotal trial, and why was it chosen?

accelerated_only.label: The path relies only on accelerated approval
accelerated_only.source: FDA surrogate endpoint table, type Accelerated
accelerated_only.dd: Does the path rely on accelerated approval, and has a confirmatory trial started?

confirmatory_trial_registered.label: A randomized confirmatory trial is registered
confirmatory_trial_registered.dd: Does the path rely on accelerated approval, and has a confirmatory trial started?

ph2_under_enrollment.label: Phase 2 under-enrolled or was stopped for enrollment
ph2_under_enrollment.source: ClinicalTrials.gov enrollmentInfo actual vs anticipated, whyStopped
ph2_under_enrollment.dd: How did enrollment go against plan in previous trials?

primary_endpoint_changed.label: The primary endpoint was changed after trial registration
primary_endpoint_changed.dd: Was the primary endpoint changed after the trial started, and why?

grade5_related.label: There were drug-related deaths (grade 5)
grade5_related.dd: Were there deaths or serious drug-related events? Provide the full safety table.

grade4_related.label: There were severe, life-threatening drug-related grade 4 adverse events
grade4_related.dd: Were there deaths or serious drug-related events? Provide the full safety table.

toxicity_at_efficacious_exposure.label: Toxicity at efficacious exposure (narrow therapeutic index)
toxicity_at_efficacious_exposure.dd: What is the margin between efficacious and toxic exposure in the most sensitive species?

crl_reason.label: FDA complete response letter and its reason (undisclosed = there was a letter, the reason was not disclosed; if you do not know whether there was a letter, leave the fact out)
crl_reason.dd: Did the asset receive an FDA complete response letter, and what is the verbatim reason?

adcom_negative.label: Negative FDA advisory committee vote
adcom_negative.dd: What were the interactions with the FDA: advisory committee votes, letters on data quality or integrity?

fda_data_integrity_letter.label: FDA letter on unreliable clinical data
fda_data_integrity_letter.dd: What were the interactions with the FDA: advisory committee votes, letters on data quality or integrity?

patent_status.label: Status of the key patent
patent_status.source: Orange Book (approved only); Google Patents, Lens.org, EPO; data room
patent_status.dd: Provide the patent list: type of protection, jurisdictions, expiry dates, freedom-to-operate opinion.

key_patent_license.label: Rights to the key patent
key_patent_license.dd: Who owns the key patent, and is the licence exclusive for the lead indication?

key_markets_outlicensed.label: Rights to the US or the EU have already been out-licensed
key_markets_outlicensed.dd: Which territories remain with the company? Are US and EU rights retained?

nonkey_territories_outlicensed_count.label: Number of out-licensed territories outside the US and the EU
nonkey_territories_outlicensed_count.dd: Which territories remain with the company? Are US and EU rights retained?

royalty_stack_pct.label: Total upper-tier royalties, %
royalty_stack_pct.dd: What royalties and milestone payments are owed to licensors? What is the total rate?

differentiation_claim.label: Claimed differentiation from the standard of care
differentiation_claim.dd: How does the asset differ from approved drugs of the same mechanism, and what data support it?

price_channel_direct.label: A channel where the payer captures the savings itself (hospitals, tenders, out-of-pocket)
price_channel_direct.source: Route of administration; CMS Part B / Part D
price_channel_direct.dd: How does the asset differ from approved drugs of the same mechanism, and what data support it?

differentiation_evidence.label: Differentiation is confirmed by clinical data (false = the claim was checked and not confirmed)
differentiation_evidence.dd: How does the asset differ from approved drugs of the same mechanism, and what data support it?

sponsor_size.label: Sponsor size
sponsor_size.dd: What is the sponsor's track record: prior approvals, partners on this asset, company size?

sponsor_prior_approvals.label: Sponsor's prior approvals
sponsor_prior_approvals.dd: What is the sponsor's track record: prior approvals, partners on this asset, company size?

big_pharma_partner.label: A big-pharma partner on this asset
big_pharma_partner.dd: What is the sponsor's track record: prior approvals, partners on this asset, company size?

partner_returned_asset.label: A partner returned the asset (licence terminated)
partner_returned_asset.dd: Has a partner ever returned rights to the asset, and why?

runway_short.label: Cash does not last until the next readout plus 6 months, or there is a going-concern warning
runway_short.source: XBRL: cash / annual burn; 10-K going concern
runway_short.dd: How many months of cash are left, and when is the next data readout?

cmo_oai_or_warning_letter.label: A site or contract manufacturer has an OAI status or a warning letter within 3 years
cmo_oai_or_warning_letter.source: FDA Inspection Classification Database; Warning Letters
cmo_oai_or_warning_letter.dd: Who manufactures the drug, and what is the status of the last FDA inspection?

approved_same_moa_same_modality_count.label: Approved drugs with the same mechanism AND the same modality class in this disease
approved_same_moa_same_modality_count.source: Open Targets knownDrugs + ChEMBL molecule type (small molecule / antibody-like / nucleic acid / gene / cell)

moa_approved_any_indication.label: The mechanism (target + direction) is approved in any indication

acute_indication.label: Acute (not chronic) indication, e.g. acute infection or injury

regulatory_exclusivity_years.label: Statutory exclusivity expected after approval (NCE 5, orphan 7, biologic 12 years)
regulatory_exclusivity_years.source: FDA Orange/Purple Book rules; orphan designation
regulatory_exclusivity_years.dd: Which regulatory exclusivities (NCE, orphan, BPCIA) will the asset get, and for which indication?

economics_negative.label: Economics negative: P(rNPV > 0) below 10% in the Monte Carlo
economics_negative.dd: How many patients will actually be treated and at what net price? Can development be narrowed or made cheaper?

economics_weak.label: Economics weak: median (P50) rNPV below zero
economics_weak.dd: Which assumption (patients, price, share, cost) would have to move to make the median rNPV positive?
